be-now.title: am, is, are
be-now.line: Who is it? Then choose am, is or are.
be-now.sayAloud: I am. She is. They are.

be-before.title: was, were
be-before.line: For Before, am and is become was. Are becomes were.

many.ex: They were hungry a while ago.

be-before.sayAloud: I was. He was. We were. They were.

have.title: has, have
have.line: One person or one thing has. Everyone else have.

we.ex: We have fun at the beach.

have.sayAloud: She has. We have. Birds have.

be-or-have.title: Be or have?
be-or-have.line: Be tells what someone is, or where. Have tells what someone owns.

many.ex: The ducks are in the pond.

be-or-have.sayAloud: I am happy. I have a ball.

past-regular.title: Add -ed
past-regular.line: Most action words add -ed for Before. Some words change a little.

patterns.ex: We walked to the park yesterday.
Mum baked a cake last week.

patterns.rule: Ends in y? Change y to ied
Short word? Double the last letter
patterns.ex: The bus stopped at the gate.

past-regular.sayAloud: walk, walked. bake, baked. cry, cried. stop, stopped.

past-irregular.title: Special words
past-irregular.line: These words don't add -ed. They change into a new word.

pairs.ex: Yesterday I went to the park.
She took the bus to school.
The cat sat on the mat.
We had fun at the zoo.

past-irregular.sayAloud: go, went. eat, ate. take, took. buy, bought.

ing-now.title: am, is, are + -ing
ing-now.line: Something happening right now: am, is or are, then the action word with -ing.

we.ex: We are waiting for the bus.

ing-now.sayAloud: I am reading. She is cooking. They are playing.

ing-before.title: was, were + -ing
ing-before.line: Something that was happening before: was or were, then the action word with -ing.

I.ex: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

we.ex: We were having dinner last night.

many.ex: The birds were singing this morning.

ing-before.sayAloud: I was walking. We were eating.

shall-will.title: shall, will
shall-will.line: School rule: I and we use shall. Everyone else uses will.

I.ex: I shall see your teacher tomorrow.

we.ex: We shall take a taxi home.

many.ex: The boys will play football later.

shall-will.sayAloud: I shall. We shall. He will. She will.

stations.ex: The plane will leave in an hour.
